explanation: Raw reset gate r[4]: timing dominates (high at D1/D2, low at GO, declining over the episode). Beyond timing, the D1 value is set by the previous trial: highest after a1 S1 rewarded (+0.095), also up after a1 S2 r / a1 S1 u; lowest after a2 S2 unrewarded (-0.126) and a2 S1 u (-0.08), i.e. a signed a1-vs-a2 / reward axis (rewarded a1 up, unrewarded a2 down). This D1 effect scales up strongly with episode trial (fitted ~0.18x at trial 0 to ~1.6x at trial 99), so long late-episode unrewarded a2 runs push it far below baseline. At GO it is higher after unrewarded trials that reached S1 (a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, +0.06), slightly lower after rewarded ones; this GO effect shrinks over the episode. Smaller: trial-before (a2 unrewarded lowers D1, a1 rewarded raises it), and at D2 rare transitions (a1->S2 lower, a2->S1 higher). Value and hidden good state add little. 8 terms (two use fixed-shape last-trial tables from the profile residuals), all observed: test R^2 beyond timing 0.667 vs 'all' ceiling 0.69 (dev 0.669); last-trial table alone 0.55 dev.

issues: The label's phrase 'a1/S1-reward evidence' is a bit loose. The D1 table is mainly an a1-vs-a2 axis plus a reward axis, not evidence about S1. a1 S2 r raises it (+0.045). a2 S2 u, which is evidence that S1 is good, gives the lowest value (-0.126). a2 S1 r is slightly positive (+0.016). The explanation text describes this correctly; only the label is imprecise.

The scores reproduce. The 8 terms give test R^2 0.6665 against an 'all' ceiling of 0.69. The four table terms alone, with their episode-trial scaling, give 0.632; the same tables without the scaling give 0.554. That confirms the claim that the episode-trial scaling is the main gain. The fitted D1 scale runs 0.178 + 0.0144*ep_trial (about 0.18x to 1.6x) and the GO scale runs 1.51 - 0.010*ep_trial (it shrinks), both matching the explanation.

A simple signed version (prev_action as +1/-1, prev_reward, each also times ep_trial) reaches only 0.44. The action-sign effect fits almost entirely through its ep_trial interaction (weight 0.001 per trial, main effect about 0), so the a1-vs-a2 part really appears late in the episode. This supports 'growing over the episode'.

misses shows no systematic error class. Mean error by phase is about 0, and the worst (phase, previous trial) cells are within +/-0.015 (D2 after unrewarded trials +0.015; D1 after a1 S2 u -0.012). The worst windows are late-episode runs of repeated a2 choices, where D1 r keeps falling (0.63, 0.61, 0.44, 0.38) faster than the model predicts and GO is under-predicted (0.29 vs 0.13). Adding a2-run terms, trial-2 choice terms, ep_trial^2, or the model's choice logit did not beat 0.667 (0.633 to 0.655), so this is not a recoverable gap.

The smaller claims check out against the profile and the fitted weights. D2 rare transitions: a1 to S2 -0.030, a2 to S1 +0.022. Trial before: a2 unrewarded -0.025, a1 rewarded +0.020. GO is higher after unrewarded trials that reached S1 (+0.062 / +0.056), while after S2-unrewarded trials it is only +0.023 / +0.004.
